name: minimum_spanning_tree
author: 3ddaa37e
description: Finds a minimum-weight spanning tree using Kruskal and Union-Find. Use to connect every node at minimum total cost. Supports connected undirected graphs, including negative weights; unweighted edges cost 1. Returns total weight and a bounded edge preview, with the complete tree registered as result_graph_id. Rejects disconnected, directed or empty graphs.

graph_id.description: ID of the graph to analyse.

top_k.description: Maximum entries in each output preview. Full scalar totals are unaffected.
